svg.aria-label: Pipeline in five stages: Source public ‘is this true?’ requests (running); Survey each chatbot in a real browser, fresh chat, repeated (built, audited); Decompose answers into atomic checkable claims (in progress); Check each claim with web search, one LLM reading all evidence (in progress); Score per chatbot with evidence attached (planned).
